plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: A handoff button above the prompt once context reaches 60%: writes a summary, saves it, clears, and continues in a fresh conversation

plugins.name: next-steps-plus
plugins.description: Up to three next-prompt suggestions after each turn, in theme-aware colors

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, git clean, force push, migrations) and shows what they would change, with Proceed and Cancel buttons. Copied unchanged from anthropics/claude-code-playground (Apache-2.0).

metadata.description: Claude Code mods: a context handoff button with an info bar, themed next-step suggestions, and Blast Radius
